title: ewf-swa-1994-television
label: Dai Kaiju

won.source: No title-change document survives; already billed EWF Television Champion, managed by Dr. Dragon, when the fed's own last recovered broadcast opens (~March 1996).

how: Title change not recorded; held it by the fed's own last recovered broadcast.
note: Retained the title against Hulk Hurley on the fed's own last recovered broadcast when a masked interloper's run-in stopped the match with no fall recorded; still champion when the surviving record breaks off.

title: ewf-swa-1994-intercontinental
label: "Stingray" Steve Fontaine

won.source: No title-win document survives; already champion by the fed's own 20 April 1995 rankings bulletin (read, not served), successfully defending against Johnny Sumbu at Shockwave (28 Feb 1995) and Championship Collision (25 Mar 1995), with one intervening non-title-affecting count-out loss to Sumbu at Ground-Zero (7 Mar 1995).

how: Title win not recorded; held it through the fed's own 20 April 1995 bulletin.
note: No document records the loss of this title; William the Conqueror held it instead by the fed's own last recovered broadcast.

won.source: No title-change document survives; already billed EWF Intercontinental Champion when the fed's own last recovered broadcast opens (~March 1996).
